# laravelcloud_domain (Data Source)

Reads an existing Laravel Cloud domain binding by ID. Useful when composing modules that reference a custom hostname binding provisioned in a separate state OR via the Cloud dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reads an existing Laravel Cloud domain binding by ID.

data "laravelcloud_domain" "production" {
  id = "dom_01HAM..."
}

output "production_hostname" {
  value = data.laravelcloud_domain.production.name
}

output "production_status" {
  value = data.laravelcloud_domain.production.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Cloud-assigned domain binding ID (ULID).

### Read-Only

- `cloudflare_managed` (Boolean) True when Cloud coordinates a Cloudflare proxied record for this hostname.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of binding creation.
- `environment_id` (String) ID of the environment this hostname routes to.
- `name` (String) Fully-qualified hostname bound to the environment.
- `redirect_from_www` (Boolean) True when Cloud 301-redirects `www.<name>` to `<name>`.
- `status` (String) Cloud lifecycle status.
- `verification` (String) DNS verification mode — `real_time` or `manual`.
- `wildcard_enabled` (Boolean) True when `*.<name>` routes to this environment.
